address: Four Seasons Hotel, The Galleria Level 1, Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi
bio: Powerbrokers, movers and shakers in Washington DC will be familiar with the original Café Milano. This elegant sibling is in the Four Seasons – and if you want to be seen enjoying la dolce vita, then start with an aperitivo in the bar. The Italian chef and his team confidently prepare authentic Italian dishes; the homemade pastas are a highlight. There’s also a great terrace.
